subject: test-journal-contamination-20260830
text: The journal entries timestamped 2026-08-30T04:56:53Z through 2026-08-30T04:56:55Z with actor 'test' were produced by the Windows operator-activation unittest run, not by the operator and not by real Aletheia actions. Treat those entries as test artifacts only. PR #55 fixed the test suite so future runs isolate durable journal writes.
